source: Sealed original training intakes 01-08. These outcomes have previously been disclosed. Roots are mechanically chosen using only realized root expenditure, the step, physical seat, nominal map and worker ID. Neither the original margin, signs, head score nor the dispersion may enter the selector.
selection: Among the 33 eligible true payments in the eight fixed blocks choose two distinct map/seat roots, one on each physical seat and distinct terrains. Select the feasible pair minimizing their total remaining transitions (equivalently, maximizing the sum of the two root turns). Resolve ties lexicographically by (seat0 seed, seat0 turn, seat0 uid, seat1 seed, seat1 turn, seat1 uid). Use both roots, no replacement.
interventions: For each root keep the original v1 order and exact single-planter alternative and common archived examiner root command. For each new pair recover both entire public histories and retain the old root examiner search-cost warm start; independently seed a fresh MT19937 continuation stream shared by the two arms before the first post-root decision. Use the two new streams for both arms through every official terminal. The original v1 and original unmodified Master3s2 search/temperature stay fixed.
resources: Existing shared native court CPUs 0/1 only. One pair in parallel at a time. Alternate parent core across the four pairs. Use flock and sealed per-arm results. Record resource at start, native search times, both physical scores and independent official action replay. Time-constrained search can alter effective trajectories even under a shared initial stream.
comparison: Oriented margin is paid-arm official own-minus-rival minus deferred-arm official own-minus-rival. Report old group and two fresh groups in time order, minimum/maximum, sample SD (n=3), within-root sign changes and actual walls per new pair. If either root changes sign flag instability on the sampled roots. No population/significance claim. Report both even if one failed to improve. No sign-dependent stopping or new full-game evaluation. No independent new map was sampled.
